# RafikiHub

> RafikiHub is a casting platform based in Nairobi, Kenya. It connects actors, models, performers and other creatives across Kenya, East Africa and Africa with casting directors, agents and producers working in film, television, theatre and commercials. Founded by actress Kate Snow. More than 65,000 members.

## Key facts
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya. Serves Kenya, East Africa and Africa.
- Who can join: actors, young performers (registered by a parent or guardian), independent performers, models, fashion stylists and designers, make-up artists, pet models, studio spaces and agents.
- For casting professionals: post casting breakdowns to registered agents and talent, search performer profiles, and shortlist for audition.
- Services: casting platform, talent management (agent representation), acting workshops, mentoring and headshot sessions.
- Contact: info@rafikihub.com, +254 114 011 932. Representation: talent@rafikihub.com.

- [Talent management](https://rafikihub.com/talent-management): agent representation for actors in Kenya
- [FAQ](https://rafikihub.com/faq): how casting works, applying for roles, headshots, confidentiality
- [About](https://rafikihub.com/about): mission and background
